summary: This directory orchestrates the routing of AI model requests by mapping identifiers to specific model configurations and managing the execution flow, including automated fallbacks for resilient request handling.
responsibilities: Manage AI model route configurations and lookup services
Define routing paths for AI model requests
Execute operations across sequences of model registry nodes
Implement fallback logic for error handling during model execution
Standardize parameters for text generation, structured object generation, and embedding tasks
relationships: A model route consists of a sequence of route nodes that define the hierarchy and configuration for model execution.
The routing service provides access to configured routes by their unique identifiers.
The execution utility consumes model routes to perform operations by iterating through nodes until a successful result is obtained or all fallbacks are exhausted.
designDecisions: Use of nominal branding for model route identifiers to ensure type safety
Implementation of a tree-based routing structure to support multi-stage fallback logic
Separation of route configuration from execution logic
Unified parameter interfaces for heterogeneous AI tasks like generation and embedding
